d: "In a groundbreaking move, Yess Pizza introduced India’s first pizza vending machine at one of its outlets. This ingenious invention works just like any vending machines. However, upon inserting a token, patrons are not simply handed a pre-made pizza; instead, they witness the marvel of an entire pizza-making process unfold right before their eyes. The machine springs to life by crafting the dough, meticulously spreading it, and then layering it with sumptuous cheese and an assortment of fresh vegetables.The entire process spans a mere 5 to 6 minutes.
